title: Concept: File access built from input (erlang) — review required
description: In erlang, file:read_file(dir ++ f) builds a file path from input, so traversal sequences can step outside the intended directory. The remedy is confinement to a base directory (filename prefix check) plus normalization and an allowlist.
applicability: erlang file access; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write; HIGH severity.
